hero.subtitle: MUSIC COMPOSITION
hero.description: Disco-funk score for a film about a stone giant who wakes up in a cave and discovers the joy of dancing. Original composer quit a week before deadline. I jumped in and wrote everything from scratch.

showcase.title: How It Happened
showcase.description: Ray is a film about a stone giant sleeping in a dark cave. Dripping water wakes him. He breaks free from the rock, notices light beams piercing through cracks - and starts dancing. Every move had to sync with the music frame by frame. When the light disappears, he tries to catch it. The film ends with credits showing Ray in various costumes. Original composer left when the film was almost done. I had one week. Got animatics, manually added sync markers, adjusted everything frame by frame. Three rounds of feedback. Main track has DJ scratches and breaks down into old cassette tape effects when Ray freezes.
showcase.list4: Cassette breakdown: real tape samples + Waves J37 slowdown

bassRhythm.title: Bass & Rhythm
bassRhythm.description: Slap bass and electric drums in the style of Chic and Earth Wind & Fire. Rhythm guitar brings that 70s feel. Every hit matched to Ray's movements.

synthsStrings.title: Brass, Sax & Synths
synthsStrings.description: Brass carries the melody, saxophones add warmth in the background. DJ scratches connect the sections. Something between Bee Gees and new wave.

finalMix.title: The Credits Version
finalMix.description: Same theme, but fuller. Gospel organs, live drums instead of electronic, Omnisphere synths. Approved instantly. Standing ovation at the cinema.
